description: List the Meta product catalogs connected to this channel's WhatsApp Business Account. Only id and name are returned unless `fields` asks for more. Use the catalog id with mba_list_catalog_products. This list is CURSOR-PAGINATED: it returns {data, paging} - page with the `after` cursor from paging.cursors, and stop when paging carries no `next` link, because a page can be empty and still have more after it.

after.description: Cursor - return the page immediately after it.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

before.description: Cursor - return the page immediately before it.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,name,product_count,vertical. Default: id,name.

limit.description: Maximum entries per page. A page can be shorter.

name: mba_list_product_catalogs
title: List product catalogs
